paper_title: First results from BRASS-p broadband searches for hidden photon dark matter
notes: First results from BRASS-p broadband hidden photon dark matter search over 49.63-74.44 ueV (12-18 GHz). Record sensitivity (0.3-1.0)x10^-13 to kinetic mixing chi, assuming unpolarized HP DM with rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3. The reported benchmark is chi ~< 10^-13 over the full mass range; data points approximate the flat sensitivity level from the abstract/text and Fig. 12 (1-sigma). Sensitivity varies (0.3-1.0)x10^-13 across the band. Mass range: 12 GHz -> 4.963e-5 eV, 18 GHz -> 7.444e-5 eV. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.8, 3))
